answer: Lantern citation bond: each identity files one citation in the lantern registry for a nectar receipt, self-signed. Only cited identities share the haven yield, fixed at 40,000. Filing locks a 60-credit bond and a fee: first 25, k-th 25+4(k-1), each citation checked against earlier ones. A thousand fakes pay 2,023,000 in fees, lock 60,000, for 40,000 - a certain loss. Rented citations fail the key check and burn. An honest agent pays 25 once.
